display.purpose: Instrument Serif — screen titles, hero numbers, the Home greeting, the wordmark. Regular weight, sentence case, nowhere else.

title.purpose: Instrument Sans 600 — card titles (venue names) and section labels.

body.purpose: Instrument Sans 400 at 15px — all reading text.

label.purpose: Instrument Sans 500 at 13px — chips, metadata, small buttons.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Bottom sheets and modals only — the single allowed shadow in the app.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: The soft press response on every tappable element.

motion.name: pl-rise
motion.purpose: Card/list entrance, staggered via animation-delay; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: color-transition
motion.purpose: Nav tab and chip active-state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one sage action on the screen — join, create, confirm.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: block; width: 100%; height: 48px; background: var(--color-accent, #5A6B4D); color: #fff; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #5A6B4D); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The quiet sibling — same pill, sunken bone fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: block; width: 100%; height: 48px; background: var(--color-sunken, #F1EEE6); color: var(--color-ink, #1C1B17); font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #5A6B4D); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill filter chip; sage tint when active, pressed bone at rest.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 14px; white-space: nowrap; background: var(--color-sunken, #F1EEE6); color: var(--color-ink-secondary, #6E6A5E); transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-chip--active { background: var(--color-accent-soft, #E8ECE2); color: var(--color-accent, #5A6B4D); }

components.name: Card
components.description: The canonical .pl-card — white linen on the bone table, hairline border, no shadow.
components.html:
Padel Club Dublin
Sat 5 Jul · 10:00–11:30 · Level 3.0–4.0
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-surface, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #E7E3D8); border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-ink, #1C1B17); } .ds-card-meta { font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-ink-secondary, #6E6A5E); margin-top: 4px; } .ds-card-meta strong { color: var(--color-ink, #1C1B17); font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Sunken pressed-bone field; the border only appears (in sage) on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--color-sunken, #F1EEE6); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: var(--color-ink, #1C1B17); outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-ink-faint, #A8A395); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-accent, #5A6B4D); }

components.name: Bottom Nav Item
components.description: One tab of the four-tab bottom nav: 22px stroke icon over a 10px label; sage when active, faint ink at rest.

narrative.overview: Padel Loop looks and feels like a calm, well-kept club you're glad to belong to. Quiet quality, a warm welcome, nothing shouting. The ground everywhere is a warm bone — never pure white — with white cards resting on it like fresh linen on a clubhouse table. One deep sage accent speaks for the whole interface: it marks the door to a game and stays silent everywhere else. The system explicitly rejects the corporate / bland SaaS look and noise in all forms: decorative drop shadows, badge clutter, promo banners, gamified streaks and confetti. Surfaces are quiet, but touch is not: every pressable thing responds softly under the thumb — full-round pills, generous radii, a gentle press-scale. Soft and tactile, never stiff.
keyCharacteristics: Warm bone ground (#FAF8F3), white cards, hairline borders — depth without shadows
One deep sage accent (#5A6B4D) used scarcely, so it's unmissable
Instrument Serif for the few words that matter; Instrument Sans for everything else
Full-round pill buttons and chips; soft press feedback (scale 0.98) on everything tappable
Mobile-first, one job per screen, primary action always in thumb reach

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Court Sage appears on at most ~10% of any screen — the primary action and active states, nothing else. Its rarity is what makes it unmissable.

rules.name: The Never-Pure-White Rule
rules.body: The page background is always Clubhouse Bone. Court White exists only on cards and sheets; a full-bleed white screen is a bug.

rules.name: The Scarce Serif Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif appears only where the brand speaks: screen titles, hero numbers, the greeting, the wordmark. Regular weight, sentence case, never bold, never uppercase. If the serif is everywhere, it's nowhere.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: If a surface needs separating, give it a 1px #E7E3D8 border, not a shadow. One shadow exists in the whole app, and it belongs to sheets.

dos: Do keep Clubhouse Bone (#FAF8F3) as the page background of every screen — white belongs to cards only.
Do reserve Court Sage (#5A6B4D) for the primary action and active states; if two things on a screen are sage, one of them is wrong.
Do use Instrument Serif only for screen titles, hero numbers, the greeting, and the wordmark — regular weight, sentence case.
Do give every tappable element the soft press response (active:scale-[0.98], 150ms ease-out) — tactile is the personality.
Do separate surfaces with 1px #E7E3D8 hairlines, and check text contrast: Quiet Ink (#6E6A5E) is for secondary text only, never body copy on tinted surfaces.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion on every animation, as .pl-rise already does.
donts: Don't drift back toward "corporate / bland SaaS" — the navy #1e5cff blue-and-white startup look was explicitly rejected and replaced by this system.
Don't add drop shadows as decoration. One shadow exists (--shadow-sheet, sheets/modals); everything else is flat with hairlines.
Don't add badge clutter, promo banners, streaks, or confetti — anything that makes a calm club feel like a busy marketplace.
Don't use pure alarm-red for danger; destructive is always the muted Clay Court Red (#A65D4E), text-only buttons.
Don't bold or uppercase the serif, and don't let it leak into body text, buttons, or labels.
Don't invent new colours or radii inline — every value flows from the tokens in src/app/globals.css (@theme).
